[[Wroth's Holy Rod]] is a [[unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Wroth Yakslapper]] in [[Grenth's Footprint]]. There are two versions due to the [[game updates/20061208|December 8th, 2006 update]].

==Stats==
Versions of this item that dropped ''since'' the 2006 update have the following stats:
: [[Holy damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Smiting Prayers]])
: [[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of Smiting Prayers [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
: [[Energy]] +5 (while [[Enchantment|Enchanted]])


Versions of this item that dropped ''before'' the 2006 update have the following stats:
: Holy damage: 11-22 (Requires 9 Smiting Prayers)
: Halves skill recharge of [[Protection Prayers]] spells (Chance:20%)
: [[HCT|Halves casting time]] of Protection Prayers spells (Chance:20%)

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for the newer version of this item with:
*A [[Smiting Rod]] from crafters [[Nago]] or collector [[Tanni Silvermane]]
OR
*One of the following [[Smiting Prayers]] [[wand]]s:
**[[Destroyer Scepter]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Scepter]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Scepter]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] "Have Faith" [[inscription]]
OR
*One of the following Smiting Prayers wands:
**[[Asuran Scepter]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Rod]] from collector [[Zaishen Divine Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Scepter]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Fan of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Scepter]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Scepter]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Smiting Rod]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Charr Scepter]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Scepter]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Scepter]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Scepter]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*Perfect [[Wand Wrapping]] [[of Memory]]
*Perfect "Have Faith" inscription


The old version cannot be replicated, as its bonuses are only available on wands with [[Protection Prayers]] or [[Divine Favor]] requirements.

==Unique counterparts==
*[[Ivor's Smiting Rod]] and [[Riseh's Wand]] have the same stats as the new version of Wroth's Holy Rod.
*The [[Protection Prayers]] version of [[Droknar's Scepter]] and [[Flannuss' Rod]] have stats nearly identical to the old version of Wroth's Holy Rod; however, they require [[Protection Prayers]].
